newsitem.title: USA: ITT to sell 5 ITT Sheratons to FelCor.
newsitem.headline: ITT to sell 5 ITT Sheratons to FelCor.

text.p: ITT Corp said Monday it has signed a definitive agreement with FelCor Suite Hotels Inc for FelCor to buy five ITT Sheraton Hotels for $200 million in cash.
The deal is part of a long-term strategic alliance, the company said in a statement.
The deal calls for Sheraton to manage the hotels for 20 years, ITT said. The transaction is expected to close by June 30.
The strategic alliance calls for ITT Sheraton to help FelCor identify acquisition opportunities. The alliance also makes the Sheraton brand name available to FelCor, it said.
FelCor will provide the capital to acquire certain existing Sheraton hotels as well as other hotels that will be converted to the Sheraton name, the company said.
